scope: Seed and invalid-candidate executions of the 15 generated frontier_combinatorics packages (built in the work-package branch with import_science.write_packages and scripts/build_suite.py, then reverted to sources), the run.py facade and an empty-candidate control, and the reproduction of every published human record with the generated evaluators (validation/human-results/frontier_combinatorics.json). Every invalid candidate was rejected (valid=false, score null, exit code 1). No model calls and no evolutionary search were run.
integration_note: On this source-only branch two tests of tests/test_science_catalog.py fail until integration: test_source_collections_are_supplemental (catalog/papers.json has no science-frontier_combinatorics entry yet) and test_original_tasks_and_all_sixty_proposals_survive_generation (the generated suite/<id>/task.json files were reverted). scripts/integrate_science.py frontier_combinatorics creates both. The QAP tasks also need python3 scripts/prepare_frontier_combinatorics.py before any audit.

full_unit_suite.assessment: 10 of the 12 (tests/test_paper_appendix.py and tests/test_doc_counts.py) fail identically on the base commit a5565677; the other 2 are the integration-dependent test_science_catalog tests above.

dropped_candidates.golomb_rulers: Optimal Golomb rulers are Sidon sets in an interval (shortest ruler for m marks = least L with an m-element Sidon set in [0, L]); the catalog already has Sidon-set tasks (math-sidon-set-interval-0-60, science-sidon-extension-of-1-2-5-11), so this would be a parametric variant.
dropped_candidates.max_cut_gset: Max-Cut is already in the catalog (dga2d-maximum-cut, science-quantum-qaoa-maxcut); no primary source publishing the best G-set cut vectors was found.
dropped_candidates.constant_weight_codes: A(n, 2d, w) is a packing number of w-sets; the catalog already has the Steiner-system packing task (science-steiner-system-s5612-packing) and binary-code tasks, so this would be a parametric variant.
dropped_candidates.low_autocorrelation_binary_sequences: Merit-factor optimisation is already in the catalog (math-littlewood-merit-factor-length41).
dropped_candidates.covering_arrays: Covering arrays are already in the catalog (pdr-covering-arrays-csplib-45).
dropped_candidates.dimacs_graph_colouring: The published best colourings (EXTRACOL page) could not be downloaded (TCP reset), and several of them are no longer the best known values (for example DSJC1000.5 83 versus 82, C2000.5 146 versus 145), so a reproduction of current records was not possible.
dropped_candidates.steinlib_steiner_trees: SteinLib publishes no solution trees and states no licence; a human record could not be reproduced.
dropped_candidates.graph_partitioning: Walshaw archive partitions are only sent on e-mail request; not requested.
dropped_candidates.rectilinear_crossing_number: Aichholzer's tables behind an expired TLS certificate.
dropped_candidates.superpermutation_n6: Not used: a July 2026 mailing-list post claims an unreviewed computer-assisted proof that 872 is optimal, so the case may be closed.
